introHtml: Sublimation printing allows for full-color, edge-to-edge designs that won't crack or peel, making it a top choice for custom yoga mats, towels, and bags. Unlike standard screen printing, sublimation infuses dye directly into the fabric, resulting in vibrant, long-lasting graphics that hold up to repeated use and washing. This decoration method is ideal for yoga studios, fitness centers, and corporate wellness programs that want to showcase intricate logos, patterns, or gradients on their branded gear.
